notes: 77 entries: 37 practical phrases (phrase_*, from rohingya_phrases_38.json) and 40 greetings vocabulary entries (greeting_*, from rohingya_greetings_40.json). Each entry's source_dataset says which set it came from.

Consolidated from rohingya_phrases_38.json, rohingya_greetings_40.json and rohingya_greetings_30.json. greetings_30 was an older copy of greetings_40 (same ids; greetings_40 filled the missing Goodbye, No, Okay, Nice and Well headwords), so the greetings_40 version of each entry is kept.

phrase_038 (Goodbye / Allah Hafez) duplicated greeting_002 (Goodbye / Khoda hafiz). It is kept as an alternative translation on greeting_002, with its review data; phrase_038 is no longer a separate entry.
--- phrase_* entries ---
Phrases marked 'source_attested' are directly taken from the CLEAR Global Gamayun kit5k parallel corpus (professionally translated by CLEAR Global translators).
Phrases marked 'ai_draft' are composed from attested vocabulary patterns found in the corpus but are not directly attested as complete sentences.
All entries require native-speaker review before use as gold evaluation data.
Corpus source: Gamayun Language Data Kits — Rohingya (5k), CC BY 4.0, CLEAR Global.
Do not treat AI-drafted entries as validated training or evaluation gold data before native-speaker review.

Each entry has sources_checked (Gamayun, VOA), second_review (IOM Rohingya Dictionary word-level check) and reference_translation (the pair to evaluate against, with origin and confidence). Regenerate with ml/translation/review_phrases.py.
Confidence: 0.95 = Gamayun sentence + IOM word check agree; 0.70 = Gamayun sentence only; 0.40 = model fallback draft; capped at 0.50 where the sources disagree.
IOM Rohingya Dictionary data is CC BY-NC-SA 4.0. Only short glosses are quoted in second_review; do not copy the dictionary into this repo.
--- greeting_* entries ---
Existing Rohingya example sentences are marked (not verified); new entries with no verified Rohingya example use null and pending_translation.
Some examples are reproduced/adapted from learning resources; other Rohingya sentences are AI drafts and may be incorrect.
The Rohingya Language Foundation dictionary is the priority for headwords; supplementary learning sites were used for attested sentences.
Do not treat these examples as validated training or evaluation gold data before native-speaker review.
2026-10-28 expansion: entries greeting_031–040 are dictionary-attested English–Rohingya pairs, not independently native-speaker-verified translations.
Existing missing headwords for Goodbye, No, Okay, Nice, and Well were filled from published dictionaries / learning resources; Greet is still pending a direct credible source.
New English example sentences are content drafts; new Rohingya example_sentence.rohingya values remain null pending translation and native-speaker review.
Source-attested and dictionary-attested mean published in a named reference, not gold-standard verified for language-model training or user-facing high-stakes translation.
